findings: - warning src/jbus/view/page.html:752 the header's "read" time is not the time of the last read once the server is gone: lost() sets NOW to Date.now() after MISS failed polls and render() writes "read " + hm(NOW), so the header moves forward on every failed poll while its title says "the time of the last read of the server" (the Done when line "the time of the last read"). heard() already keeps lastAnswer: show that

- warning src/jbus/view/page.html:670 troubles() is a second copy of the health rules the overview row's chips apply (projectRow, line 716 on), and the two already disagree: a project with blind > 0 and nothing else wrong gets an amber "Blind N" chip on its row and a green dot in the sidebar. One helper per health fact, read by both the chips and the dot (both reviewers)
- warning tests/fixtures/jbus-view/probe.js the pull request is wider than its brief: this file is outside the Where line

- info src/jbus/view/page.html:1002 on a link to a project that does not exist the sidebar has no projects until the next poll, up to 15 s: when the /stack.json answer comes after the 404, "if (S) render()" skips the render, since S is null there

- info src/jbus/view/page.html:645 machineOf() returns null on a project route with no read (the first load, and the "no such project" view), so the machine row and its heading are hidden there though STACK.machine is in hand, against the comment "drawn once, in the sidebar, on every view" (both reviewers)
